<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="compare-deployment-options"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#compare-deployment-options">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Compare deployment options</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">For most organizations, Claude for Teams or Claude for Enterprise provides the best experience. Team members get access to both Claude Code and Claude on the web with a single subscription, centralized billing, and no infrastructure setup required.</span>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Claude for Teams</strong> is self-service and includes collaboration features, admin tools, and billing management. Best for smaller teams that need to get started quickly.</span>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Claude for Enterprise</strong> adds SSO and domain capture, role-based permissions, compliance API access, and managed policy settings for deploying organization-wide Claude Code configurations. Best for larger organizations with security and compliance requirements.</span>
<span data-as="p">Learn more about <a class="link" href="https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9266767-what-is-the-team-plan" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">Team plans</a> and <a class="link" href="https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9797531-what-is-the-enterprise-plan" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">Enterprise plans</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">The deployment options compared below cover where model inference runs. To run Claude Code <a class="link" href="/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web">cloud sessions</a> on compute your organization operates, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/self-hosted-environments">self-hosted environments</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">If your organization has specific infrastructure requirements, compare the options below:</span>
<table><thead><tr><th>Feature</th><th>Claude for Teams/Enterprise</th><th>Anthropic Console</th><th>Amazon Bedrock</th><th>Claude Platform on AWS</th><th>Google Cloud’s Agent Platform, formerly Vertex AI</th><th>Microsoft Foundry</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Best for</td><td>Most organizations (recommended)</td><td>Individual developers</td><td>AWS-native deployments</td><td>AWS Marketplace billing with Claude API features</td><td>GCP-native deployments</td><td>Azure-native deployments</td></tr><tr><td>Billing</td><td><strong>Teams:</strong> $150/seat (Premium) with PAYG available<br/><strong>Enterprise:</strong> <a href="https://claude.com/contact-sales?utm_source=claude_code&amp;utm_medium=docs&amp;utm_content=third_party_enterprise">Contact Sales</a></td><td>PAYG</td><td>PAYG through AWS</td><td>PAYG through AWS Marketplace</td><td>PAYG through GCP</td><td>PAYG through Azure</td></tr><tr><td>Regions</td><td>Supported <a class="link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/supported-countries" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">countries</a></td><td>Supported <a class="link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/supported-countries" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">countries</a></td><td>Multiple AWS <a class="link" href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/models-regions.html" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">regions</a></td><td>Multiple AWS regions</td><td>Multiple GCP <a class="link" href="https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/learn/locations" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">regions</a></td><td>Multiple Azure <a class="link" href="https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/explore/global-infrastructure/products-by-region/" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">regions</a></td></tr><tr><td>Prompt caching</td><td>Enabled by default</td><td>Enabled by default</td><td>Enabled by default</td><td>Enabled by default</td><td>Enabled by default</td><td>Enabled by default</td></tr><tr><td>Authentication</td><td>claude.ai SSO or email</td><td>API key or a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/authentication#sign-in-without-an-api-key">Console sign-in without one</a></td><td>API key or AWS credentials</td><td>API key or AWS credentials</td><td>GCP credentials</td><td>API key or Microsoft Entra ID</td></tr><tr><td>Cost tracking</td><td>Usage dashboard</td><td>Usage dashboard</td><td>AWS Cost Explorer</td><td>AWS Cost Explorer</td><td>GCP Billing</td><td>Azure Cost Management</td></tr><tr><td>Includes Claude on web</td><td>Yes</td><td>No</td><td>No</td><td>No</td><td>No</td><td>No</td></tr><tr><td>Enterprise features</td><td>Team management, SSO, usage monitoring</td><td>None</td><td>IAM policies, CloudTrail</td><td>IAM policies, CloudTrail</td><td>IAM roles, Cloud Audit Logs</td><td>RBAC policies, Azure Monitor</td></tr></tbody></table>
<span data-as="p">For a feature-by-feature breakdown of what’s available on each option, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/feature-availability">Feature availability</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">Select a deployment option to view setup instructions:</span>
<ul>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/authentication#claude-for-teams-or-enterprise">Claude for Teams or Enterprise</a></li>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/authentication#claude-console-authentication">Anthropic Console</a></li>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/claude-apps-gateway">Claude apps gateway</a>, a self-hosted gateway that adds IdP sign-in in front of Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud’s Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry, or the Anthropic API</li>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/amazon-bedrock">Amazon Bedrock</a></li>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/claude-platform-on-aws">Claude Platform on AWS</a></li>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/google-vertex-ai">Google Cloud’s Agent Platform</a></li>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/microsoft-foundry">Microsoft Foundry</a></li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">For Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI, you can also run <code>claude</code> and select <strong>3rd-party platform</strong> at the login prompt to launch an interactive setup wizard.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="configure-proxies-and-gateways"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#configure-proxies-and-gateways">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Configure proxies and gateways</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Most organizations can use a cloud provider directly without additional configuration. However, you may need to configure a corporate proxy or LLM gateway if your organization has specific network or management requirements. These are different configurations that can be used together:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Corporate proxy</strong>: Routes traffic through an HTTP/HTTPS proxy. Use this if your organization requires all outbound traffic to pass through a proxy server for security monitoring, compliance, or network policy enforcement. Configure with the <code>HTTPS_PROXY</code> or <code>HTTP_PROXY</code> environment variables. Learn more in <a class="link" href="/docs/en/network-config">Enterprise network configuration</a>.</li>
<li><strong>LLM Gateway</strong>: A service that sits between Claude Code and the cloud provider to handle authentication and routing. Use this if you need centralized usage tracking across teams, custom rate limiting or budgets, or centralized authentication management. Configure with the <code>ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL</code>, <code>ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL</code>, <code>ANTHROPIC_AWS_BASE_URL</code>, <code>ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL</code>, or <code>ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL</code> environment variables. Learn more in <a class="link" href="/docs/en/llm-gateway">LLM gateways</a>.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">For the per-provider environment variables that route Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry, or Google Cloud’s Agent Platform through an LLM gateway, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/llm-gateway-connect#route-to-a-cloud-provider-through-a-gateway">route to a cloud provider through a gateway</a>. Run <code>/status</code> in Claude Code to verify which provider, base URL, and proxy a session is using.</span>
<span data-as="p">If your organization uses <a class="link" href="https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/cmek" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">customer-managed encryption keys</a> (CMEK) and routes Claude Code through an LLM gateway or a custom <code>ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL</code>, CMEK doesn’t apply to Claude Code’s operational telemetry on those sessions. To turn telemetry off for every developer, deliver <code>DISABLE_TELEMETRY</code> through managed settings as shown in <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings#turn-telemetry-off-for-your-organization">Turn telemetry off for your organization</a>.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="best-practices-for-organizations"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#best-practices-for-organizations">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Best practices for organizations</span></h2>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="invest-in-documentation-and-memory"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#invest-in-documentation-and-memory">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Invest in documentation and memory</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">We strongly recommend investing in documentation so that Claude Code understands your codebase. Organizations can deploy CLAUDE.md files at multiple levels. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/memory#choose-where-to-put-claude-md-files">where CLAUDE.md files can live</a> and <a class="link" href="/docs/en/memory#deploy-organization-wide-claude-md">how to deploy an organization-wide CLAUDE.md</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="simplify-deployment"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#simplify-deployment">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Simplify deployment</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">If you have a custom development environment, we find that creating a “one click” way to install Claude Code is key to growing adoption across an organization.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="start-with-guided-usage"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#start-with-guided-usage">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Start with guided usage</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Encourage new users to try Claude Code for codebase Q&amp;A, or on smaller bug fixes or feature requests. Ask Claude Code to make a plan. Check Claude’s suggestions and give feedback if it’s off-track. Over time, as users understand this new paradigm better, then they’ll be more effective at letting Claude Code run more agentically.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="pin-model-versions-for-cloud-providers"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#pin-model-versions-for-cloud-providers">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Pin model versions for cloud providers</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">If you deploy through <a class="link" href="/docs/en/amazon-bedrock">Amazon Bedrock</a>, <a class="link" href="/docs/en/google-vertex-ai">Google Cloud’s Agent Platform</a>, <a class="link" href="/docs/en/microsoft-foundry">Microsoft Foundry</a>, or <a class="link" href="/docs/en/claude-platform-on-aws">Claude Platform on AWS</a>, pin specific model versions using <code>ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL</code>, <code>ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL</code>, <code>ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL</code>, and <code>ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL</code>. Without pinning, model aliases resolve to Claude Code’s built-in default for that provider, which can lag the newest release and may not yet be enabled in your account. Pinning lets you control when your users move to a new model. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/model-config#pin-models-for-third-party-deployments">Model configuration</a> for what each provider does when the default is unavailable.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="configure-security-policies"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#configure-security-policies">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Configure security policies</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Security teams can configure managed permissions for what Claude Code is and is not allowed to do, which cannot be overwritten by local configuration. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/security">Learn more</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="leverage-mcp-for-integrations"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#leverage-mcp-for-integrations">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Use MCP for integrations</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">MCP is a great way to give Claude Code more information, such as connecting to ticket management systems or error logs. We recommend that one central team configures MCP servers and checks a <code>.mcp.json</code> configuration into the codebase so that all users benefit. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/mcp">Learn more</a>.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="next-steps"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#next-steps">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Next steps</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Once you’ve chosen a deployment option and configured access for your team:</span>
<ol>
<li><strong>Roll out to your team</strong>: Share installation instructions and have team members <a class="link" href="/docs/en/setup">install Claude Code</a> and authenticate with their credentials.</li>
<li><strong>Set up shared configuration</strong>: Create a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/memory">CLAUDE.md file</a> in your repositories to help Claude Code understand your codebase and coding standards.</li>
<li><strong>Configure permissions</strong>: Review <a class="link" href="/docs/en/security">security settings</a> to define what Claude Code can and cannot do in your environment.</li>
</ol></div><div class="feedback-toolbar pb-16 w-full flex flex-col gap-y-8"><div class="flex flex-row flex-wrap gap-4 items-center justify-between"><p class="inline-block text-sm text-gray-600
